_note: Sallow Fen, levels 5-6: sneak past what you can't fight. See docs/zones.md.

sf_causeway.name: The Causeway
sf_causeway.description: A causeway of old timbers across the fen. It sinks a little under every step.

sf_reeds.name: The Reedbanks
sf_reeds.description: Reeds taller than you, and fog between them. Lights move in it after dark.

sf_peatcut.name: The Peat Cuts
sf_peatcut.description: Black trenches where peat was cut, full of water and leeches.

features.trenches: Something big wallowed through here and flattened the banks. The tracks go south-east.

sf_chapel_yard.name: The Chapel Islet
sf_chapel_yard.description: A dry hummock with a chapel on it, and a bell on a post.

sf_chapel.name: The Fen Chapel
sf_chapel.description: A tiny chapel of grey stone, warm with candles. Sister Odile lives here.

sf_mire.name: The Mire
sf_mire.description: Mud to the knee, and a stink of troll. Huge footprints lead on.

sf_wallow.name: Gnasher's Wallow
sf_wallow.description: A pool of warm mud, and in it, mostly asleep, Old Gnasher. Past him, a heap of bones and loot.

sf_bones.name: The Bone Heap
sf_bones.description: Everything the troll ever ate or liked the look of.

features.heap: Bones, a cartwheel, a helmet with a head still in it.

reliquary.name: Saint Sallow's reliquary
reliquary.description: A small silver box with a finger-bone in it. It hums when you hold it.

odile.name: Sister Odile
odile.label: Hermit
odile.description: a thin nun in a mud-hemmed habit
odile.details: A thin nun in a mud-hemmed habit.

topics.work: The chapel's reliquary was stolen by the troll. And the leeches. And the lantern-men. Ask me about the reliquary, the leeches or the lanterns.

reliquary.text: Old Gnasher took Saint Sallow's reliquary when he flattened the old chapel. It's on his bone heap, past his wallow. You can't fight him, child. Creep past while he dozes, take it, and creep out again.

leeches.text: Giant leeches in the peat cuts. Six of them, and I'll make a salve from what's left.

lanterns.text: The lantern-men come out at dusk and lead travellers into the deep water. Put out three of them. They only show after dark.

topics.gnasher: Old Gnasher. He's eaten three knights. Don't be the fourth.

leech_salve.description: Odile's salve, from what the leeches had in them. Works best in damp weather.

oilcloth_waders.name: Oilcloth Waders
oilcloth_waders.description: Odile's spare waders, blessed and waxed. +1 Resilience.

get.goal: Creep past Old Gnasher in his wallow (CREEP), and GET RELIQUARY from the bone heap beyond.

back.goal: Get out the same way, and bring it to Sister Odile: USE RELIQUARY ON ODILE.

effects.text: Odile weeps a little. "Saint Sallow's home. Take these: they kept me dry for twenty years."

kill.goal: Kill six giant leeches in the peat cuts and the mire.

back.goal: Tell Odile: ASK ODILE ABOUT LEECHES.

kill.goal: Put out three lantern-men. They're in the reeds and on the causeway, but only at dusk and night.

back.goal: Tell Odile: ASK ODILE ABOUT LANTERNS.
